title: incident-bot: prioritized sampling for on-call auto-diagnostics and SLO context weighting
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: on-call engineers receive too many undifferentiated auto-diagnostics during noisy paging windows. This PR implements prioritized sampling for incident-bot's on-call auto-diagnostics pipeline and improves SLO context weighting in the SLO toolkit helpers so that runbook suggestions and quicklinks rank higher for runbooks that historically resolve similar symptoms.

What this changes: integrated a sampling prioritizer that scores incoming SLO violation events by urgency, historical on-call resolution signal, and confidence from diagnostics heuristics. Events with higher priority are sampled at a higher rate for full auto-diagnostics and runbook ranking. Lower-priority events receive compact diagnostics (short summary + top-1 runbook) or deferred enrichment. Also adds new weighting factors to slo-toolkit helpers: resolution_success_rate, runbook_recent_use, and owner_response_latency.

Files touched (high level): incident_bot/sampling/prioritizer.py (new), incident_bot/pipeline/enrichment.py (sampling hooks), slo_toolkit/helpers/context_weighting.py (weights + tests), incident_bot/tests/test_prioritizer.py, incident_bot/tests/test_sampling_integration.py, docs/oncall/autodiagnostics-priority-sampling.md, metrics/queries/incident_bot_sampling.promql, infra/k8s/incident-bot-deploy.yaml (minor env var), CHANGELOG.md.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-1423)
- [x] Unit tests added for prioritizer and weighting functions
- [x] Integration test simulating noisy paging window
- [x] Metrics emitted for sampled vs compact diagnostics and priority buckets
- [x] Docs updated with tuning guidance and rollout plan

Testing: Local unit test coverage added for prioritizer score permutations and edge cases. Integration test runs in CI that replayed historical SLO events showing a 40% reduction in full-diagnostic load at equivalent high-precision recall for high-severity incidents. QA performed on staging with feature flag incident_bot.priority_sampling=true.

Rollout plan: Feature gated by priority_sampling flag, start at 5% of traffic for 24h, monitor incident_bot.sampling.full_diagnostics_rate and oncall.response_time, then 25%/50%/100% with 24–48h observation windows and rollback criteria documented in the PR.

Backward compatibility: default weighting values match existing behavior (no runtime change) until config is tuned. No breaking API changes.

Notes: Initial CI run had a lint failure (flake8) and a flaky integration test; flake8 fixed in commit "fix: lint and type hints" and flaky test stabilized by increasing test timeout and refactoring mocking of external metrics store.
